summary: Delegated administration is now in every edition, and a new install run needs fewer database rights.

new.title: Delegated administration for everyone
new.text: Community now includes the Delegated role: a person who may stage and commit only within their tier, level, service and Azure scope. PIM Manager refuses anything outside those limits.

fixes.title: Fewer database rights during setup
fixes.text: Running the install again on an existing installation does most database work through the installation's own database job, so you are no longer added as database administrator for those steps.

fixes.title: Edition list kept in step
fixes.text: The Free and Pro list in PIM Manager matches the published feature list again.
